article.title: The World Bank’s flawed poverty estimates
article.author: Editor
article.content: The World Bank has just come out with estimates of poverty in India which show that “extreme poverty” which afflicted 27.1 percent of the total population in 2011, now afflicts only 2.6 percent. Its estimate is based on the National Sample Survey data on consumption expenditure collected over the period 2022-23 and 2023-24. The post The World Bank’s flawed poverty estimates appeared first on MR Online .
